name: Advanced Filesystem: Webhooks
description: Dispatches HTTP webhooks (Slack, Teams, n8n, Zapier, custom endpoints) on file events — upload, delete, and antivirus/quota/LGPD events raised by other Advanced Filesystem sub-modules. HMAC-signed payloads, async queue delivery with retries, and a delivery log.
project_description: The Webhooks sub-module of Advanced Filesystem turns file-lifecycle events into outbound HTTP webhooks. On hook_file_insert and hook_file_delete — and on antivirus.infected, quota.exceeded and lgpd.finding events raised by sibling Advanced Filesystem sub-modules — it POSTs a JSON payload to each configured endpoint that subscribes to that event. Endpoints are managed on an admin settings form; each has a URL, an optional HMAC signing secret (payloads are signed with an X-ADFS-Signature: sha256=… header), a set of subscribed events and an active flag. Delivery can be synchronous or, by default, asynchronous through a queue worker with bounded retries. Every attempt is recorded in a delivery-log table with the event, endpoint, HTTP status and error, prunable on cron by a retention window. A per-endpoint 'send test event' action posts a synthetic test.ping. All administration is gated behind the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_webhooks' permission.
